findings.evidence: Their imported results occur only in proof bodies: Exponential/PDF.lean:56 uses rnDeriv_gammaMeasure, Exponential/Measurability.lean:28 uses measurable_gammaMeasure, and Pareto/Basic.lean:105 uses measurable_paretoPDF; the exported statements do not mention those dependency APIs.
findings.fix: Make these proof dependencies ordinary `import`s; add direct public imports only for modules defining names occurring in exported signatures (for example Probability.Density in Exponential/PDF).
findings.issue: Proof-only dependencies remain `public import`s: Gamma.PDF here, Gamma.Measurability in Exponential/Measurability.lean:8, Measure.Measurability in Beta:9, Binomial:8, Cauchy:8, Gamma:9, Pareto:8, and Poisson:8 measurability modules, Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Gamma in Beta:8 and Gamma:8, and Pareto.PDF in Pareto/Basic.lean:10. Importing these family modules therefore exposes unrelated APIs and defeats the intended family-specific surface.

summary: Several family modules publicly re-export proof-only dependencies, so the split still leaks unrelated Gamma and shared measurability APIs through canonical family imports.
